title: org.ligatureprotocol.role
description: DRAFT. The payload of a role signature made in the pairing ceremony (spec chapter 02 section 3), carried in an envelope signed by the introducer's self-signing key (roles binding and principal) or by the user-signing key (role person). The domain ligatureprotocol.org is a placeholder; it is not yet registered.

publicKey.description: A public key as a multibase string with a multicodec prefix (an Ed25519 key renders as z6Mk…).

subject.description: The key being signed: a binding key, a principal key, or another person's master key.

role.description: binding: my account on a device; principal: a device I use; person: another master key I know.

person.description: The master key of the person on whose behalf the signature is made.

introducer.description: For role binding: whether the new binding holds the self-signing key and may perform the ceremony for others.
